hypothesis: If all domestic pigeon breeds descend from Columba livia and its geographic sub-species, then whole-genome variation of every domestic breed nests within the C. livia radiation (with feral and wild-type C. livia), and no breed clusters outside it or with another wild species as a separate ancestral lineage.
pass_criterion: In a genome-wide SNP phylogeny and ABBA-BABA D-tests built from public C. livia breed resequencing reads, with Columba rupestris (or C. oenas) as outgroup, 100% of sampled domestic breeds fall in a clade with C. livia (bootstrap >= 90% on the node uniting all breeds and C. livia to the exclusion of the outgroup); no breed shows excess allele sharing with the outgroup (|Z| < 3); and mean autosomal divergence of each breed to C. livia is at most half its divergence to the outgroup.
fail_criterion: One or more domestic breeds form a well-supported clade (bootstrap >= 90%) outside the C. livia clade, or any breed shows significant excess allele sharing with a non-livia species (|Z| >= 3) consistent with a separate aboriginal stock, or breed-to-outgroup divergence is less than 2 times breed-to-C. livia divergence.
interpretation: Darwin's 'aboriginal wild stocks' are read as separate wild species-level lineages (e.g. C. rupestris, C. oenas, C. palumbus) that could each have been independently domesticated; 'geographical sub-species' is read as geographic populations of C. livia, including feral birds. Descent is measured as phylogenetic nesting plus introgression tests on genome-wide SNPs. Modern reinterpretation: minor gene flow from relatives at a few loci would not falsify the claim; only a distinct ancestral lineage would. Caveat: the NCBI Taxonomy node for Columba livia (taxid 8932) is the entry point to linked genome assemblies, BioProjects and SRA runs, including resequenced breed genomes; specific run accessions would be selected from those linked records at analysis time.

dataset.name: NCBI Taxonomy: Columba livia (taxid 8932), with linked genome assemblies, BioProjects and SRA runs
dataset.why_it_fits: The node links to the C. livia reference genome and public SRA whole-genome resequencing runs for domestic breeds and feral birds, plus outgroup Columba reads, from which SNPs, phylogeny and D-statistics can be computed. Fields used: SRA run accession, sample/breed attributes, FASTQ reads, assembly FASTA.
